newsitem.title: USA: CSCE called slightly lower on producer selling.
newsitem.headline: CSCE called slightly lower on producer selling.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures were called to open slightly lower on producer selling after weakness overnight in the LIFFE white sugar contract.
Dealers reported light producer selling in the London white market from French producers, coupled with general weakness associated with a large long speculative position on this side of the Atlantic.
Monday, CSCE October settled off 0.07 cent at 11.58 cents a lb after trading from 11.56 to 11.68 cents. Technical support is pegged at 11.47 cents, dealers said.
